info.name: Yearn Finance yDaemon REST Chains TVL API
Get total TVL for a chain

params.name: chainID
params.description: The EVM chain ID. Supported values: 1 (Ethereum), 10 (Optimism), 137 (Polygon), 250 (Fantom), 8453 (Base), 42161 (Arbitrum).

items.docs: Returns the Total Value Locked (in USD) aggregated across all vaults on the specified chain.
